fusions.name: Spore Roar
fusions.desc: Roars out a cone of spores that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and makes them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Rotten Fruit Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a rotten fruit into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Mycelial Rally
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Overgrowth
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
